name: com.lingkyn.xr-ui-shell.core
description: Engine-light world-space UI shell substrate: PanelId, WristMenuId, HandMenuId, and InputSourceId identity with one canonical dotted-segment form, a shell layout model (the closed AnchorKind set, panel/wrist-menu/hand-menu declarations with an admitted anchor-kind set, and the closed placement-intent set open/close/focus/dock/follow), intent application to an immutable ShellState with deterministic replay and a fingerprint, typed pointer and gaze routing from registered input sources that resolves to exactly one open panel or a named no-target result, a skin contract mapping the shared design-language tokens to a closed shell-slot set, and structured results with stable failure codes.

samples.description: Domain-only walkthrough: declaring a panel, a wrist menu, and a hand menu, opening and focusing them, docking a secondary panel to a primary one, routing a ray hover and a gaze select through a registered commit source, and mapping the canonical skin; no asset, scene, or UnityEngine API.
